title: Report data redaction
responsibility: Redacts recognized credential patterns and removes sensitive URL parts from recorded text and data.

outputs.name: sanitize
outputs.description: Text with recognized authorization tokens, secret assignments and key/token patterns replaced by redaction markers. HTTP(S) URLs lose user information, query and fragment; Stripe checkout URLs also lose their path.

outputs.name: cleanData
outputs.description: Strings sanitized recursively through arrays and enumerable object fields, with matching sensitive keys replaced entirely by a redaction marker. Other primitive values remain unchanged.
